## Ovi API

Ovi is an image to video model by Character.AI, available on the Venice API as `ovi-image-to-video`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Ovi is Character.AI's open-weight audio-video model, based on Wan, that animates a starting image into a 5-second clip with native audio. It runs fast and is served uncensored.

### Ovi API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ovi-image-to-video` | Image to video | Private | from $0.044 / sec |

### Ovi specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Character.AI |
| Released | Sep 25, 2025 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Modes | image to video |
| Durations | 5s |
| Audio | Always generated |

### How to use the Ovi API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "ovi-image-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "ovi-image-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "5s",
    "image_url": "https://example.com/first-frame.jpg"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "ovi-image-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
